calibration.applies_to: total predictive variance (latent + prediction-time binomial noise)

forbidden_readings: that P(wall) predicted here is the wall-loss probability of a real thruster or of a self-consistent plasma
that the surrogate is accurate outside the interpolation scope (the extrapolation assessment is reported, its gate may fail)
that passing the interpolation gates validates the orbit or field models
that the ARD length-scales, permutation importances or tree feature importances are physical sensitivities rather than sensitivities of the screening dataset
that a v2 improvement over v1 is evidence about the physics rather than about the input representation of a surrogate
claim_boundary.prior_surrogate_failures_disclosure: Nineteen earlier surrogate campaigns (l0_surrogate v1-v9, l1a_field_surrogate v1-v10) failed their predeclared gates or were invalidated (lack of physically varying data, non-group-valid conformal ranks, a tautological target). wall_loss_geometry_surrogate_v1 (the first on physically varying data) was recorded rejected_surrogate: pooled RMSE 0.056 > 0.05, floor-corrected cell RMSE 0.128 > 0.05, best-baseline ratio 1.11 < 2 (coverage 0.90 passed). Its permutation importance placed almost all signal on the step-discontinuous design selectors (stage_count_selector, exit_length_fraction), which a stationary GP on the raw selectors cannot represent. v2 changes exactly the input representation (and adds a tree baseline) and keeps v1's roles and gates verbatim so the result is directly comparable.
claim_boundary.statement: Surrogate of a SCREENING dataset; not physical-orbit evidence; not a performance model. The targets are orbit-integration outcome counts on L1a screening fields; the surrogate reproduces those counts' probabilities within a declared accuracy inside a declared interpolation scope. Nothing here validates the orbit model, the field model, the mirror picture or any thruster figure of merit. The v1-vs-v2 comparison compares two surrogates of the same screening dataset; it says nothing about physics.
usable_as: if accepted: a design-dependent wall-loss input for an MDO v2 that carries the SCREENING label and the interpolation scope (predictor.json marked usable_as_mdo_v2_input_with_screening_label)
a sensitivity report of which DERIVED geometry / field features drive the screening wall-loss probability
a paired comparison (same 16 assessment designs, same 10 extrapolation designs) of raw-design-parameter inputs (v1) against derived physical features (v2)
a learning curve quantifying what a v3 with more designs could expect

classification_statement: A learned surrogate (DERIVED physical geometry and field features -> collisionless test-particle wall-loss probability per axial cell) of the SCREENING_L1A_FIELD_TEST_PARTICLE_WALL_LOSS dataset produced by modern/experiments/orbit_wall_loss_geometry_screening_v1. Every prediction inherits that label: it is a surrogate of a SCREENING dataset on L1a linear-vacuum fields (not P2-qualified), never physical-orbit evidence, never a plasma or thruster-performance model. v2 tests ONE change against v1 on the identical frozen roles: whether a Gaussian process (or a per-stage-count GP mixture) on realised geometry / field descriptors, instead of the raw design selectors whose step discontinuities defeated v1, interpolates the screening dataset to v1's predeclared accuracy with calibrated uncertainty; and whether a tree ensemble (which represents steps natively) does better. It does not test physics.

excluded_recorded_quantities.design_values.* (the eleven v1 raw desig: deliberately excluded: v1 showed the step discontinuities of the design -> geometry map dominate; v2 tests realised geometry instead
excluded_recorded_quantities.field.sweep_qois.axis_cusp_positions_m (: count equals stage_count for every design (verified); positions enter through the per-cell cusp distances
excluded_recorded_quantities.field.sweep_qois.axis_null_positions_m (: count equals stage_count + 1 for every design (verified); positions enter through the per-cell null distances
excluded_recorded_quantities.field.sweep_qois.field_peak_t: near-duplicate of bore_max_b_t (grid peak vs bore-grid peak); one peak descriptor is kept
excluded_recorded_quantities.geometry.chamber_length_m: equals stage_count * stage_pitch_m exactly for every design (verified); kept only as the extrapolation-cluster rule
excluded_recorded_quantities.geometry.dielectric_thickness_m: not a channel-interior quantity; wall_radius_m carries the interior geometry

provenance.bore_max_b_t: field.bore_max_b_t (maximum |B| on the screening's bore grid)
provenance.cell1_cusp_distance_pitches: launch_design.cell_to_field[gs1-cell-1].nearest_axis_bz_peak_distance_m / geometry.stage_pitch_m (axial distance from the cell centre to the nearest axis |Bz| peak, in pitches)
provenance.cell1_null_distance_pitches: launch_design.cell_to_field[gs1-cell-1].nearest_axis_null_distance_m / geometry.stage_pitch_m (distance to the nearest axis Bz null / cusp plane, in pitches)
provenance.exit_length_fraction_realised: geometry.exit_length_m / geometry.chamber_length_m (realised, after the sweep's minimum-length rule; NOT the design selector)
provenance.exit_length_m: geometry.exit_length_m (realised divergent exit-section length; 0 when the sweep suppressed the exit)
provenance.exit_outer_radius_ratio: geometry.exit_outer_radius_m / geometry.wall_radius_m (1 when there is no divergent exit)
provenance.exit_start_m: geometry.exit_start_m (axial start of the exit section)
provenance.first_polarity: geometry.first_polarity (+1 / -1 realised polarity of the first stage)
provenance.log10_minimum_mirror_ratio: log10(field.sweep_qois.minimum_mirror_ratio) (L1a sweep QoI; log because the ratios span two decades)
provenance.straight_length_m: geometry.exit_start_m - geometry.injector_length_m (channel straight length L from the injector face to the exit-section start)
provenance.wall_radius_m: geometry.wall_radius_m (r_w of the straight dielectric channel)

feature_manifest.statement: every feature is a deterministic arithmetic function of the committed screening dataset row (geometry, field.sweep_qois, launch_design.cell_to_field); no feature is fitted, tuned, scaled by data statistics, or learned; the extraction code (features.py) is bound by hash in the code contract

inputs.known_discontinuities: none by construction: the steps of the design -> geometry map (stage count, polarity, exit suppression) are realised categorical / one-hot features or realised lengths, not continuous selectors

interpolation_scope.statement: features inside the fit-role unit box and realised chamber length (stage_count x stage_pitch_m) below the extrapolation threshold (top-decile chamber lengths were held out); predictions outside carry the extrapolation caveat

mdo_v2_input_status_note: provisional at development time: the final status is written to campaign-result.json after the single-use assessment (usable only if every binding gate passes); a consumer must read campaign-result.json.mdo_v2_input_status
observation_noise_rule: added unscaled to the calibrated latent variance: logit scope 1 / (n p_hat (1 - p_hat)) with p_hat = clip(sigmoid(m), 0.5 / (n + 1), (n + 0.5) / (n + 1)); direct scope p_hat (1 - p_hat) / n with p_hat = clip(m, 1 / (n + 2), (n + 1) / (n + 2)); the observation interval is the interval an independent n-launch replicate should fall in
prediction_rule: probability = inverse transform of the working latent mean; latent interval = inverse transform of mean +/- z_0.90 sqrt(scale * latent variance); observation interval = inverse transform of mean +/- z_0.90 sqrt(scale * (latent variance + binomial noise at the predicted mean)); outputs with a dispatch rule route each design to the block of its stage_count feature
